code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full uniform lines are the panel boundaries.
    hlines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    vlines = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Keep only separator-colored full lines; full-line colors are excluded

    rowcuts, colcuts = [-1] + hlines + [h], [-1] + vlines + [w]
    rowpanels = [(rowcuts[i]+1, rowcuts[i+1]) for i in range(len(rowcuts)-1)]
    colpanels = [(colcuts[i]+1, colcuts[i+1]) for i in range(len(colcuts)-1)]
    sepcolors = {grid[r][0] for r in hlines} | {grid[0][c] for c in vlines}
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row if x not in sepcolors)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0] if counts else 0
    # The panel with the most foreground cells is the source pattern.
    best = None
    for ri, (r0,r1) in enumerate(rowpanels):
        for ci, (c0,c1) in enumerate(colpanels):
            score = sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
            if best is None or score > best[0]:
                best = (score,ri,ci)
    _, sri, sci = best
    sr0,sr1 = rowpanels[sri]; sc0,sc1 = colpanels[sci]
    ph,pw=sr1-sr0,sc1-sc0
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rowpanels):
        for ci,(c0,c1) in enumerate(colpanels):
            if r1-r0 != ph or c1-c0 != pw:

            flip = (ci-sci) % 2 != 0
            for dr in range(ph):
                for dc in range(pw):
                    srcdc = pw-1-dc if flip else dc
                    out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = grid[sr0+dr][sc0+srcdc]
    return out
'''
